item.tib: dpal gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor las rgyud bskang gter gyi phreng ba
item.coloph: ces dpal gsang ba 'dus 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor las rgyud bskang gter gyi phreng ba 'di yang 7spyang 'phags gdung grol mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags dang*/ rigs mthun grogs po tshul khrims blo gros lhan nas bskul ba la brten/ rgod rje rgya yi gdung las dal rten rnyed pa'i 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bla ma'i cha tsam gtogs pa des kun bzang bde chen pho brang du sbyar ba'o//
